t: Powerful Erbauer 240V Electric plunge saw delivers powerful, precise performance for demanding trade applications. Driven by an 1800W motor with 6-speed control, the saw is ideal for sizing down work, sink cut-outs in kitchen worktops and trimming doors. The plunge function allows accurate depth setting, while the scribing mode ensures splinter-free results. Can cut just 16mm from walls, allowing floorboards to be cut in place. Also features switch lock mode with constant speed during use and anti-kickback. Supplied with 2 x 700mm finely adjustable guide rails with lock, F-clamps, and accessories for accurate, stable operation on every cut. The plunge saw also allows bevel cuts, with bevel cut angle adjustment from 0-48°. Scoring cut mode provides clean cuts, full cut mode can be used for regular cuts, and the parallel guide enables accurate cuts along the workpiece edge without use of the track. Blade change mode for easy blade change. Can be plunge cut into the workpiece.
